source_dataset: HydroSHEDS v2.0 North America BAS beta / RIV v2r0

connections.name: Culverson Creek karst drainage
connections.downstream_route: Culverson Creek caves → springs on Spring Creek → Greenbrier → New → Kanawha → Ohio → Mississippi
connections.citation: Jones, W. K. (1997), Karst Hydrology Atlas of West Virginia, Karst Waters Institute Special Publication 4, p. 90 and Greenbrier County tracer tables
connections.evidence: Dye traces connect Culverson Creek Cave to four resurgences on Spring Creek. Both source polygons terminate at the same modeled Culverson sink. This connection corrects ultimate basin membership; the surface polygons are not a surveyed groundwater divide.
